title: Saving the release plan from HQ drops each story's reason
tier_reason: Code behind the Product page's plan editor; git reverts it, and the loss it prevents is silent data loss on a surface the CEO edits.
ask: Found 2026-09-09 while answering what is on the roadmap for the next release. Stories in hq/data/release_plan.json now carry a 'why' and a 'raised' date (the ripe-crop glance and the bed outline both do). The plan editor's save handler in hq/server.py keeps only id, title, estimate_days and done, so the next time the CEO saves the plan from the page, every story's reason is thrown away.
first_action: In hq/server.py, in the release-plan save handler (the function that rebuilds each story dict with id/title/estimate_days/done before writing release_plan.json), carry through any other fields the stored story already has ('why', 'raised', 'shipped_in', and anything else unknown), merging by story id against the kept plan so the page cannot lose what it did not show. Add a test that round-trips a plan with a 'why' through the save handler and asserts it survives.
source_message: Chief of staff session 2026-09-09: reading the release plan while answering the CEO's question about the next release.
model_note: Opus for now: the week's Fable budget is spent (Daniel, 2026-09-21). Remove this field to return to the seat's default.
